cases.name: scope append array current local
cases.code: f(){ local a; a=(one two); local a+=tail; printf "<%s>\n" "${a[@]}"; }; f

cases.name: scope append array current declare
cases.code: f(){ local a; a=(one two); declare a+=tail; printf "<%s>\n" "${a[@]}"; }; f

cases.name: scope append array missing zero
cases.code: f(){ local a; a[2]=two; local a+=tail; printf "<%s>\n" "${a[@]}"; }; f

cases.name: scope append array shadow control
cases.code: a=(one two); f(){ local a+=tail; printf "<%s>\n" "${a[@]}"; }; f; printf "<%s>\n" "${a[@]}"

cases.name: scope append reference current target
cases.code: t=one; f(){ local t=base; local -n r=t; local r+=two; echo "$r:$t"; declare -p r; }; f; echo "$t"

cases.name: scope append reference declare target
cases.code: t=one; f(){ local t=base; local -n r=t; declare r+=two; echo "$r:$t"; declare -p r; }; f; echo "$t"

cases.name: scope append reference global target
cases.code: t=one; f(){ local -n r=t; local r+=two; echo "$r:$t"; declare -p r; }; f; echo "$t"

cases.name: scope append reference caller target
cases.code: t=one; f(){ local t=base; g; echo "$t"; }; g(){ local -n r=t; local r+=two; echo "$r:$t"; declare -p r; }; f; echo "$t"

cases.name: scope append reference chain
cases.code: t=one; f(){ local t=base; local -n r=t; local -n s=r; local s+=two; echo "$s:$r:$t"; declare -p r s; }; f; echo "$t"

cases.name: scope append reference indexed target
cases.code: f(){ local a; a=(one two); local -n r=a; local r+=tail; printf "<%s>\n" "${a[@]}"; declare -p r; }; f

cases.name: scope append reference readonly target
cases.code: f(){ local -r t=base; local -n r=t; local r+=two 2>/dev/null; echo "$?:$r:$t"; declare -p r; }; f

cases.name: scope append reference outer alias shadow
cases.code: t=one; declare -n r=t; f(){ local r+=two; echo "$r:$t"; }; f; echo "$r:$t"

cases.name: scope append prefix intervening local
cases.code: x=outer; f(){ local x=caller; g; echo "$x"; }; g(){ local x+=a; echo "$x"; }; x=1 f; echo "$x"

cases.name: scope append prefix intervening declare
cases.code: x=outer; f(){ declare x=caller; g; echo "$x"; }; g(){ declare x+=a; echo "$x"; }; x=1 f; echo "$x"

cases.name: scope append prefix intervening bare local
cases.code: x=outer; f(){ local x=caller; g; echo "$x"; }; g(){ local x; echo "<$x>"; }; x=1 f; echo "$x"

cases.name: scope append prefix ordinary caller guard
cases.code: x=outer; f(){ local x=caller; g; echo "$x"; }; g(){ local x+=a; echo "$x"; }; f; echo "$x"

cases.name: scope append prefix nested twice guard
cases.code: x=outer; f(){ g; echo "$x"; }; g(){ local x+=a; h; echo "$x"; }; h(){ local x+=b; echo "$x"; }; x=1 f; echo "$x"

cases.name: scope append prefix current append repeated
cases.code: x=outer; f(){ local x=caller; local x+=a; g; echo "$x"; }; g(){ local x+=b; echo "$x"; }; x=1 f; echo "$x"

cases.name: scope append prefix second nested local guard
cases.code: x=outer; f(){ local x=caller; g; }; g(){ local x=second; h; }; h(){ local x+=a; echo "$x"; }; x=1 f; echo "$x"

cases.name: scope append prefix unset clears inheritance
cases.code: x=outer; f(){ local x=caller; unset x; x=again; g; }; g(){ local x+=a; echo "$x"; }; x=1 f; echo "$x"
